title: NetZero Planika Renew Ethanol Vent Free Fireplace
description: Brilliant. Mesmerizing. Modern. And one of the most clean-burning fireplaces in existence. Powered by renewable bioethanol, the versatile NetZero Renew biofuel fireplace requires zero venting. Which means you can place it almost anywhere to bring your unique design vision to light. Speaking of light, only NetZero Fire offers an array of LED lighting packages – for even more ways to customize and enhance the rich, ribbon-like flames.
